name: duo-image
title: Duo Image
description: Composites a screenshot into an iPhone Duo frame - closed, closed-at-an-angle, closed-landscape, unfolded-landscape or unfolded-portrait - with zoom/focus cropping and click-to-open in the shared lightbox.
docs: The frame PNGs are not installed by this command - shadcn inlines file contents as UTF-8 text, which corrupts binary files. Download all five from public/frames/ in the repo and place them at public/frames/ in your project: https://github.com/mattdahlberg/DuoFrameDisplay/tree/main/public/frames
